content: pi (badlogic/pi-mono) steering: two input modes toggled with Tab, default via /mode or settings steeringMode. Steering mode injects queued user message into conversation when the CURRENT TOOL CALL finishes, before next API call — model sees it mid-turn between LLM calls. Follow-up mode waits until entire turn completes then sends as new message. Esc interrupts/aborts immediately. Rationale: injection points are boundaries between API calls.
